lines.odette_2_a: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Oh, it is you. Come in out of the road.
lines.odette_2_b: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. I keep meaning to ask how the farm is doing.

lines.odette_2_r2: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Then sit a minute. The shop will keep.

lines.rosmarin_4_b: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. Take this seed. Plant it where the sun stays long, and bring the fruit to the old stone in the Secret Woods.
